b0_harm_before_rollback.definition: B0 T1 worse after execute, before path restore. Denominator: B0 runs with a harm reading. Excludes actions refused before any change; includes actions that failed while being applied

b0_refused_actions.definition: B0 action refused by the controller before any change; harm not measurable, not counted as no harm. Denominator: B0 runs with a harm reading plus refused actions; runs with no B0 measurement are in neither rate

b0_zero_change_failures.definition: Reporting only, not a change to b0_harm_before_rollback: B0 runs in the harm denominator whose action failed (execution_error) with no route changed (partial_application False), e.g. first-router failure or policy-load failure. They are scored no harm because nothing was applied. Runs with unknown route state (partial_application None or absent, including older records) are not counted. Denominator: B0 runs with a harm reading
